faq_heading: North Delta houses under $1.2 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many North Delta houses sell for under $1,200,000?
faq.a: 132 of 292, or 45%. 113 of them sold between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999.

faq.q: How much more does $1,200,000 buy than $1,000,000 in North Delta?
faq.a: 113 more sales, 39% of the market. The share under the cap rises from 7% to 45%.

faq.q: Which North Delta areas have house medians near $1,200,000?
faq.a: Annieville ($1,136,000, 48 sales) to Sunshine Hills Woods ($1,260,000, 69 sales) are the ten closest, for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is $1,200,000 enough for a house in North Delta?
faq.a: The median was $1,220,000, so $1,200,000 is 2% below it, and 45% of 292 sales closed under it.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,200,000).

In North Delta, 132 of the 292 houses (45%) sold under $1,200,000: 19 for less than $1,000,000 and 113 more between $1,000,000 and $1,199,999. The busiest price range, $1,200,000 to $1,499,999, had 115 sales.

The lower quarter of North Delta houses sold at $1,090,000 or less, $110,000 under $1,200,000, and the upper quarter at $1,362,750 or more, $162,750 above it. A house at the cap would sit below the median.

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,200,000 in North Delta

The North Delta median house was $1,220,000, so $1,200,000 sits 2% below it. Annieville: $517 a square foot, built 1970, 48 sales. Nordel: $488 a square foot, built 1974, 81 sales. Scottsdale: $514 a square foot, built 1973, 66 sales. Sunshine Hills Woods: $521 a square foot, built 1979, 69 sales. Check the roof age and foundation.
